A. E. W. Mason, The Four Feathers.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/a-e-w-mason/the-four-feathers

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- A. E. W. Mason, the annotator and author, died 1948 (citizenship: United Kingdom, United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland).

First publication of the text used: 1902 (SE colophon: 'The Four Feathers was published in 1902 by A. E. W. Mason.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1902, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1997.
- Country of origin (the country of first publication is not named in the facts; possible countries: United Kingdom, Ireland, United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, South Africa): each of these countries has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1948, so the work is public domain in each of them from 1 January 2019.
